$comment: Renderer configurations for `npm run bench -- --compare` (docs/DEV_TOOLS.md; scripts/configs.ts describes the fields). Each scenario runs once per configuration and is compared with the baseline. A configuration whose renderer or upscaler the build doesn't offer (`__dwell.renderers()`, `__dwell.upscalers()`; without them, only `raster`) is skipped with a note. The full-resolution march runs since A3b, the FSR 1 and bilateral upscaled ones since A4; TAA-U waits for A5 (docs/RAY_MARCHED_RENDERER.md).

configs.name: painterly
configs.notes: The mesher with the painterly texture set (docs/PAINTERLY_TEXTURES.md): the same atlas size, meshes and shaders, other texels; the frame cost should match raster's.

configs.name: outline-silhouette
configs.notes: The mesher with the ink outline's silhouettes (docs/ART_DIRECTION.md §7, shared/look/outline.json): its cost is the composite's.

configs.name: outline-creases
configs.notes: The mesher with the ink outline's silhouettes and creases.

configs.name: outline-blocks
configs.notes: The mesher with the ink outline's silhouettes, creases and block edges.

configs.name: raster-half
configs.notes: The mesher at half resolution, stretched by the browser (today's ?scale=).

configs.name: march-nobeam
configs.notes: Ray-marched at full resolution without the beam prepass (A4b's before), every frame marched.

configs.name: march-notemporal
configs.notes: Ray-marched at full resolution with the beam prepass but no temporal start (A4b), every frame marched.

configs.name: march-a4b
configs.notes: Ray-marched at full resolution as A4b left it: the temporal start only while the eye is still and no brick uploaded, the column search in every mixed brick, and every frame marched (A4c's before).

configs.name: march-nosteep
configs.notes: Ray-marched at full resolution, every frame marched, with the column search in every mixed brick (before A4c's slope rule).

configs.name: march-noreuse
configs.notes: Ray-marched at full resolution, marching again even when nothing changed since the last frame (before A4c's kept frame).

configs.name: march-half-fsr
configs.notes: Ray-marched at half resolution, FSR 1 upscaling (A4).

configs.name: march-075-fsr
configs.notes: Ray-marched at three-quarter resolution, FSR 1 upscaling (A4).

configs.name: march-half-bilateral
configs.notes: Ray-marched at half resolution, depth- and normal-aware bilateral upscaling (A4).

configs.name: march-half-taa
configs.notes: Ray-marched at half resolution, TAA-U upscaling (A5).

configs.name: march-075-taa
configs.notes: Ray-marched at three-quarter resolution, TAA-U upscaling (A5).
